direct_API.operation: observe(image_bgr, raw_points, K, native_xyz, coarse_pose, *, pallet_mask=None, state_pallet_mask=None, independent_truncation=None, crop_transform=None)
direct_API.inputs: original uint8 BGR, branch q8/q9, original K, native_xyz=C.cuboid(*branch_own_Fpose.cf_extents), branch own F R_cf/centroid/R_physical and extents
direct_API.returns: initial_geometry, state_observation, mask_audit, visible_correction and frozen_visible_measurements; observe does not optimize a pose
direct_API.common_BI_only_usage: Use state_model and mask_provider with ot_model=None and branch-accurate prediction_source; domains then remain broad metadata and are not passed as calibrated source evidence to a new common BI-only pose solver. Do not call solve_observations for the simpler common BI+PnP experiment.

state_contract.S: recompute separately from each own registered coarse pose by outward-face visibility; fixed before mask prompts/local queries
state_contract.BI: coarse model projected convex-hull membership fixes boundary/interior role, not actual visibility
state_contract.query_gate: initial S erased; invalid/missing/OOB raw nonS query abstains U unless independent truncation evidence or explicit conditional geometric rule; in-canvas q overrides uncertain coarse T in v4
state_contract.O: frozen actual RGB classifier at each branch own gated query, not target-mask complement or detector confidence
state_contract.T: independently certified truncation optional; coarse-only truncation is conditional, not a physical certificate; interval_v4_2 requires its separate source-specific CAL artifact
state_contract.decision: p>=.98 retains branch initial B/I; p<.96 gives O when enabled; middle U
state_contract.raw_confidence_note: Preserve raw confidence as source metadata. Do not treat it as actual visibility probability or replace frozen RGB classifier.

mask_contract.Tiny: full-frame image-only frozen segmentation; exact same image/model/canvas output may be shared by value when bindings are verified, but existing provider recomputes it on every call
mask_contract.MobileSAM: same frozen vit_t weights, box-only with multimask_output=True and maximal SAM quality selected; box is min/max of each branch finite in-canvas nonS raw queries, index8 excluded
mask_contract.per_branch_fresh_prompt_required: Unless original q eligible IDs and box are exactly identical with current image/model/canvas, replaying N3 mask as raw mask is not the same pipeline. Own pose can change S, hence prompt subset. Encoder could be shared only as a separately verified computational reuse, not by reusing a mismatched selected mask.

correction_contract.guidance: branch own projected physical edges; actual target-mask boundary for B and RGB junction for I
correction_contract.saved_fields: actual rays/support and intersection, corrected/fallback reason, blend alpha, measured xy/covariance, source, queried IDs
correction_contract.confidence: line contrast/RMS and bootstrap intersection conditional covariance; this is not raw YOLO keypoint confidence or guaranteed CAL coverage
correction_contract.fallback: original branch point and configured fallback covariance

source_policy_caveat.state_model_same_frozen_parameters_for_t: valid controlled engineering reuse; raw-domain visibility accuracy/coverage is not newly calibrated

next_renderer_contract: Same fixed10 cases, two columns with matched input/state/mask+actualBI/measurement displacement/common-solver-final rows. All intermediate values must be saved by the new runner; no invented optimizer trajectory. Postseal numeric metric display only with ROOT GO.
